resources.string: Lets one back swipe close the suggestion bar and go back in the app. While the Sym panel is open, TitanKeys also reads the keys that you push, so that Enter and Backspace turn the pages and do not go to the app. In the Smart Launcher search field, TitanKeys also reads the keys that you push, so that Hold for symbols and two pushes of Shift or Alt operate correctly. While you type, TitanKeys also sees when the notification shade opens and closes, so that a notification at the top of the screen does not take the touchpad. TitanKeys does not read your screen.
